results.answer: The foreign transaction fee on a debit card is 2.5% of the amount.
The foreign transaction fee on a credit card is 3.0% of the amount.
Replacing a lost credit card costs 100,000 VND.
The annual fee for a credit card is 300,000 VND, and it is waived when the spending is at least 50,000,000 VND per year.
The bank charges 28% per year interest on an unpaid credit card balance if the statement balance is not paid in full by the due date.
Yes, if your dispute about a payment you actually made is rejected after investigation, a handling fee of 80,000 VND applies.
You must report an unauthorized payment within 60 days after the payment date. Reports submitted after this 60-day window are reviewed on a case-by-case basis, and you may be liable for the amount.

As a provisional credit for an unauthorized payment, you will get your money back within 5 working days while the bank investigates, unless the payment was confirmed with your own OTP or biometric check.
No, a card locked because of a fraud dispute is replaced free of charge.
An OTP is valid for 3 minutes and is used for one payment only.
After entering 5 wrong OTPs, the card's online payments are paused for 30 minutes.
A single transfer in the app requires a biometric check from 10,000,000 VND or more.
